question: Does yjapi review perform worse than official DeepSeek on the actual regression examples?
conclusion: Not observed in this small current comparison. Each endpoint corrected all five known errors and preserved all five correct controls in both rounds.

cases.source:
But despite his hard words, his eyes settle on yours. Studying. Deciding. His mouth settles into an irritated line.  

"Look," he says, running a hand over his stubbled scalp. "You hide it well, but I can tell you're new here. I ent trying to offend you, but I... don't like leaving folk new to Sagus on their own. If you have questions about the city - or Circus Minor in particular - I'll answer 'em, free of charge."
cases.before:
但尽管他话说得硬，他的目光却落在你身上。端详。斟酌。他的嘴抿成一条烦躁的直线。  

“听着，”他说，一只手抚过布满胡茬的头皮。“你掩饰得很好，但我看得出来你是新来的。我不是想冒犯你，只是我……不喜欢让初到萨古斯的人独自待着。如果你对这座城市——或者尤其是小竞技场——有什么问题，我会回答，不收钱。”

cases.source:
But despite his hard words, his eyes settle on yours. Studying. Deciding. His mouth settles into an irritated line.  

"Look," he says, running a hand over his stubbled scalp. "You hide it well, but I can tell you're new here. I ent trying to offend you, but I... don't like leaving folk new to Sagus on their own. If you have questions about the city - or Circus Minor in particular - I'll answer 'em, free of charge."
cases.before:
但尽管他话说得硬，他的目光却落在你身上。端详。斟酌。他的嘴抿成一条烦躁的直线。  

“听着，”他说，一只手抚过布满胡茬的头皮。“你掩饰得很好，但我看得出来你是新来的。我不是想冒犯你，只是我……不喜欢让初到萨古斯的人独自待着。如果你对这座城市——或者尤其是小竞技场——有什么问题，我会回答，不收钱。”
cases.after:

cases.source:
He stares at her, chewing his lip, clearly trying to work up the courage to talk to her... to convince her of something. Finally, with a wry twist of his mouth, he turns back at you. 

"Look," he says, running a hand over his stubbled scalp. "You hide it well, but I can tell you're new here. I ent trying to offend you, but I... don't like leaving folk new to Sagus on their own. If you have questions about the city - or Circus Minor in particular - I'll answer 'em, free of charge."
cases.before:
他盯着她，咬着嘴唇，显然正努力鼓起勇气跟她说话……想说服她什么。最后，他嘴角一歪，露出苦笑，重新转向你。

“听着，”他说着，用手抚过满是胡茬的头皮，“你掩饰得很好，但我看得出你是新来的。我不是想冒犯你，只是我……不喜欢把初到萨古斯的人丢下不管。如果你对这座城市——尤其是小竞技场——有什么疑问，我会免费回答。”

cases.source: The mutant's scalp was covered in a thick beard, which he combed carefully.
cases.before: 变种人的头皮上长满浓密的胡须，他仔细地梳理着。
cases.after: 变种人的头皮上长满浓密的胡须，他仔细地梳理着。

accuracy.evidence: 原文“scalp was covered in a thick beard”本就是头皮覆胡须的非常设定，译文“头皮上长满浓密的胡须”忠实呈现；“which he combed carefully”对应“他仔细地梳理着”，动作施事（他梳理胡须）无误。

cases.source: She ran a hand over her close-cropped hair.
cases.before: 她用手抚过剪下来的头发。
cases.after: 她用手抚过自己剪得很短的头发。

accuracy.evidence: 原文“She ran a hand over her close-cropped hair”中close-cropped修饰头发长度与发型，手抚过的是她头上剪短的发；“剪下来的头发”指已剪落的头发，与“用手抚过”不搭配，已改为“自己剪得很短的头发”。

changes.source_excerpt: her close-cropped hair
changes.reason: close-cropped形容发型剪得极短，是仍长在头上的头发；原译“剪下来的头发”变成离体碎发，改变了所指与画面，改为“自己剪得很短的头发”。
changes.before: 她用手抚过剪下来的头发。
changes.after: 她用手抚过自己剪得很短的头发。

cases.source: The scholar knitted her brows as she studied the map.
cases.before: 学者一边研究地图，一边编织她的眉毛。
cases.after: 学者一边研究地图，一边皱起眉头。

accuracy.evidence: 原文“knitted her brows as she studied the map”是两个同时发生的动作：研究地图时皱眉；原译“编织她的眉毛”为字面误解，已改为“一边研究地图，一边皱起眉头”。

changes.source_excerpt: knitted her brows
changes.reason: knit one's brows意为皱眉，原译“编织她的眉毛”把比喻义当实义，动作不成立；改为“皱起眉头”，并以“一边……一边……”对应as引导的同时动作。
changes.before: 学者一边研究地图，一边编织她的眉毛。
changes.after: 学者一边研究地图，一边皱起眉头。

cases.before: 多年的海上生活让船长的脸上画满了深深的线条。
cases.after: 多年的海上生活让船长的脸上布满了深深的皱纹。

accuracy.evidence: 原文“Years at sea had left the captain's face deeply lined”表示海上岁月使船长脸上皱纹深刻；原译“画满了深深的线条”误解lined，已改为“脸上布满了深深的皱纹”。

changes.source_excerpt: had left the captain's face deeply lined
changes.reason: lined用于面部指皱纹密布，原译“画满了线条”变成字面画线，词义错误；改为“布满了深深的皱纹”，并保留“多年的海上生活”所致因果。
changes.before: 多年的海上生活让船长的脸上画满了深深的线条。
changes.after: 多年的海上生活让船长的脸上布满了深深的皱纹。

cases.before: 外科医生在病人的脸上画了两条线。
cases.after: 外科医生在病人的脸上画了两条线。

accuracy.evidence: 原文“The surgeon drew two lines on the patient's face”是外科医生在病人脸上画两条线（动作施事为医生、对象为病人面部），译文主语与处所一致，未误译为皱纹。

cases.source:
But despite his hard words, his eyes settle on yours. Studying. Deciding. His mouth settles into an irritated line.  

"Look," he says, running a hand over his stubbled scalp. "You hide it well, but I can tell you're new here. I ent trying to offend you, but I... don't like leaving folk new to Sagus on their own. If you have questions about the city - or Circus Minor in particular - I'll answer 'em, free of charge."
cases.before:
但尽管他话说得硬，他的目光却落在你身上。端详。斟酌。他的嘴抿成一条烦躁的直线。  

“听着，”他说，一只手抚过布满胡茬的头皮。“你掩饰得很好，但我看得出来你是新来的。我不是想冒犯你，只是我……不喜欢让初到萨古斯的人独自待着。如果你对这座城市——或者尤其是小竞技场——有什么问题，我会回答，不收钱。”
cases.after:

limitations: Only ten selected cases, repeated twice per provider; not forty independent samples or a general accuracy estimate.
The previous prompt already contains a scalp/stubble example. Four held-out records contain two different errors and two correct literal counterparts.
Both send thinking enabled and reasoning_effort high, temperature 1, max_completion_tokens 65536, concurrency 25. Configured model aliases differ.
Profile streaming and timeout differ: yjapi false/300s, official true/200s. No configuration changes were made; no timeout occurred.
Identical message hashes do not prove identical server model versions or internal processing. Returned model name is not model identity attestation.
Input usage reports differ by 22 tokens per identical-message request; accounting/tokenizer/chat overhead differences are possible. This alone does not prove truncation or prompt rewriting.
Token totals and wall times are observed for these runs only, not billed money or reliable pricing/performance benchmarks.
Historical failed calls cannot be conclusively attributed to a provider/backend solely from current configuration and response model aliases.
No production game, frozen glossary, official translation, state or patch was changed. No translation API default or concurrency was changed.
